summary.intent: Execute gap closure plans (21-08 through 21-11) for Phase 21 (BYO IPFS node support), fixing verification gaps identified in the prior verification pass.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 completed successfully (21-08 SDK config wiring, 21-09 TEE-routed connection test, 21-10 PinataProvider) with 10 commits across 3 parallel agents. Wave 2 (21-11 benchmarks) was spawned after user configured Pinata credentials.

repo: PinataProvider uses Pinata v3 native API (not PSA) — Pinata deprecated their PSA endpoint, requiring a dedicated provider with pinByCid for CID-based pinning and direct-upload routing in sdk/client.ts
BYO pinning config is stored as an encrypted IPNS entry and must be loaded at login via loadByoConfig in useAuth.ts, not at SDK init time
Connection testing previously ran in the browser causing CORS failures with SaaS providers — now routed through TEE with ECIES encryption of credentials
SSRF validation logic was duplicated in migration-worker and connection-test; extracted to tee-worker/src/services/ssrf-validation.ts as shared module in 21-09
PinningConfig type was not exported from @cipherbox/sdk package index — needed an auto-fix addition to packages/sdk/src/index.ts
